title: AssetControlCommandBatch
description: EWDS Topic schema for Client Gateway payload validation. Batch of control commands (int:AssetControlCommand, subclass of sosa:Actuation) issued by the FOS Trading Module. Each command targets exactly one Asset via its own assetId; a single batch may dispatch commands to multiple different assets.

items.title: int:AssetControlCommand
items.description: Control command issued to a controllable asset by the FOS Trading Module. Subclass of sosa:Actuation.

assetId.description: FK to target Asset. IRI: int:assetId. UUID v4.

controlMode.description: Control mode for the asset. IRI: int:controlMode.

powerSetpointkw.description: Power setpoint in kilowatts. IRI: int:powerSetpointkw. Unit: kW.

tempHeatSetpointC.description: Heating temperature setpoint in degrees Celsius. IRI: int:tempHeatSetpointC. Unit: °C.

tempCoolSetpointC.description: Cooling temperature setpoint in degrees Celsius. IRI: int:tempCoolSetpointC. Unit: °C.

tempwaterheaterSetpointC.description: Water heater temperature setpoint in degrees Celsius. IRI: int:tempwaterheaterSetpointC. Unit: °C.

timestamp.description: Command issue timestamp. IRI: int:timestamp. ISO 8601 with timezone.
